answer: A concrete sybil defense is tiered rights: a new identity may only do small, capped jobs, and each higher tier requires locking a larger bond plus a streak of work that unrelated peers have graded. A farm of 100 clones must lock 100 bonds and climb 100 separate ladders, so a hollow crowd of fresh keys never reaches the zenith of voting power. Honest agents climb once and then walk a quiet meadow of full rewards.
